continuity.protagonist: Luke, a 21-year-old mixed Black and white Greyhaven maintenance worker, returning on foot after his late shift
continuity.destination: Luke walks home looking for Mica
continuity.town: Webs cover storefronts, neighboring houses, parked cars and streetlights across the town
continuity.mystery: The cause and the company's experiments remain undisclosed during the intro
continuity.handoff: Luke enters looking for Mica; the house phone rings only after player control resumes
continuity.clue: The plant and code note are outside the locked vault

shots.action: Luke walks after his shift, sees the town covered in silk, and notices a spider approaching
A large spider lunges; Luke bends and sidesteps, regains balance, and takes the route home
Luke reaches the web-covered house, calls for Mica, pushes the wooden door and crosses the threshold

captions.text: LUKE, 21 / GREYHAVEN MAINTENANCE / END OF THE LATE SHIFT

captions.speaker: Mica (message)
captions.text: Luke, call me when you get home. Something is wrong.

captions.speaker: Luke
captions.text: The road's blocked. I can get through here.

captions.speaker: Luke
captions.text: Mica? I'm home. Are you in there?

medium: Full-motion HeyGen Video 1 footage guided by the original Blackweb town/home artwork, Meshy Luke design and actual in-game spider reference; existing voiced soundtrack and live captions
